title: iOS client: native kith app for iPhone and iPad
description:
A native iOS/iPadOS client for kith. Connects to the user's own kithd over their Tailscale network.

Scope:
- Tailscale SDK integration (Tailscale ships an iOS SDK / Network Extension) to reach tailnet from device
- JMAP session bootstrap; contact list, chat list, message thread (1:1 and group)
- Send/receive messages; read receipts
- Attachment upload (Photos, Files) and download with QuickLook preview
- Push: APNs as wakeup, EventSource for content (kithd has no APNs knowledge — use a local notification bridge or poll on wakeup)
- Background fetch / silent push for new-message notifications
- Target: Swift + SwiftUI; iOS 16+ minimum; Human Interface Guidelines
- Distribution: App Store; consider TestFlight for beta
